Referral Note (primary care provider)

Ms. Ashford is a 51-year-old registered nurse I follow for hypothyroidism, which is well controlled on levothyroxine. She reports poor sleep for close to a year. She is tired during the day, more irritable, and says she is having a harder time concentrating and keeping up at work. She has tried over-the-counter sleep aids with little benefit. Her thyroid function is within normal limits and she has no other active medical problems. I would appreciate a psychiatric evaluation and treatment recommendations.

Behavioral Observations (on arrival)

Appearance: Appears fatigued. Neatly dressed in work scrubs.

Speech: Normal.

Mood / Affect: Mood "exhausted." Affect mildly constricted.

Thought / Perception: Thought processes logical. No psychosis.

Cognition / Insight: Alert and oriented. Insight and judgment intact.
